line.comment: * SCRIPT NAME: Mayhem.GetShipPowerSupply.Point
* DESCRIPTION: Same as Mayhem.GetShipValue.Point, but it returns an array containing the ship's fleet power (element 0) and ship's supply cost (element 1).
* AUTHOR: DATE: 5 February 2026
* This is a ship.
* Point value system is based strictly on the relative Value of a ship as defined in 12.cat/dat.
* Freighters do not count toward military power.
* Ship modifiers. Default is 4 (100%). OWPs (1.8+) and springblossom (1.9.2+) cost 25% less.
* Faction further modifies maker race.
* Xenon: 0.75x (their ships are expensive and cost 0 pops). OCV: 1.5x (their ships are extremely dirt cheap and cost-effective).
* The divide-by-100 is done here rather than with $price to reduce quantization.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Militia fighters do not cost supply.
* Should never happen. Just in case.
* Mordan9 - added recursion into owned ships, as Carriers and TM's were not even considering their own support fighters.
* Check any owned support ships. These could be M6's or smaller. Anything that is both owned and can dock.
* Add-Ons 1.6.1: include docked support ships only when $calcTotalPower is FALSE (rare; avoid double counting in normal callers).
* This is a ship type.
* Herobetty 5.1: If the ship does not exist (e.g., this script is called from Mayhem.SpawnScaled.xml), then we need the relvalue of the shiptype that was passed in.
* Calculate ship military power first.
* Ship modifiers. Default is 4 (100%). OWPs (1.8+) and springblossom (1.9.2+) cost 25% less.
* Modify supply based on maker race. Xenon cost 25% less; OCV cost 50% more.
